args.reason:
DECISION: Is the missing fixture file an intentional gap or a merge artifact?
Why: the review round cannot complete without knowing which
Class: R2
1. treat it as a gap and request the fixture - blocks the round on the implementer
2. proceed and flag it in the review comment - risks passing a round with untested behavior
Recommend: 1 - a judging role should not guess at test coverage
Learn: if this recurs, add a pre-review fixture-presence check
